name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2010 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 2010 record supports: the techniques ATT&CK lists for the objects it ties to 2010, G0066 Elderwood and S0203 Hydraq (reportedly Operation Aurora, disclosed by Google on 12 January), campaign C0002 Night Dragon (November 2009 to February 2011) and S0603 Stuxnet (discovered 2010, only the techniques a 2010 primary describes), and behavior described by Microsoft's bulletins and advisories, ICS-CERT's and US-CERT's Stuxnet records, the Shadows in the Cloud report, Apache's JIRA incident report, the Firesheep release, the Justice Department and FBI Zeus releases and the 2011 PayPal indictment release, with the US-China Commission's account of the Aurora lure graded Reported. No 2010 source prints an ATT&CK id. The ten ATT&CK for ICS techniques listed for Stuxnet are in the separate layer navigator/case-studies/chronicle-2010-ics.json. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2010.md. Scores: 100 an ATT&CK object prints the id, 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 50 only a Reported source supports the behavior, 40 the mapping is Inferred.
